key.name: cascade-monitor
key.summary: Cascade the windows of the monitor under the pointer
key.description: Keyboard shortcut for the Cascade Windows command.

key.name: cascade-monitor-force
key.summary: Cascade the monitor under the pointer, ignoring the exclusion rules
key.description: Keyboard shortcut for the Cascade Windows command that ignores the "exclude" rules of the configuration file.

key.name: cascade-workspace
key.summary: Cascade the windows of every monitor of this workspace
key.description: Keyboard shortcut for the Cascade Workspace command. Not set by default.

key.name: cascade-all
key.summary: Cascade the windows of every workspace
key.description: Keyboard shortcut for the Cascade All Workspaces command. Not set by default.

key.name: undo-cascade
key.description: Keyboard shortcut for the Undo Cascade command. Not set by default.
